# The repositories swept daily by .github/workflows/vuln.yml.
#
# WHY THESE AND NOT ALL 1800: these are the tools that hold the GitHub token,
# refuse a push, or produce the figures every other decision is taken from. An
# advisory reachable from one of them is reachable from the thing that guards
# everything else, so they are worth a clone a day. Sweeping the whole fleet
# daily is a different job with a different cost, and is not this one.
#
# WHAT A SWEEP OF THIS LIST HAS ALREADY FOUND, by hand, 2026-10-22:
# GO-2026-6809 (CVE-2026-111943, crypto/x509 Certificate.Verify, published the
# day before, fixed in go1.26.10 and go1.27.3) was REACHABLE -- not merely
# present -- in FOUR of them: gitsafe, fleettools, modfloor and landingkit.
# Nothing would have reported it; a person happened to run a sweep. All four
# are at go 1.27.3 now.
#
# ADDING A LINE is the whole procedure. A repository with no go.mod is reported
# NO-GO rather than failing the lane, so a non-Go repository here is noise, not
# a break.
#
# ⛔ A HAND-KEPT LIST DRIFTS, and this one already did: written on 2026-10-22
# from the organisations as they then were, it was missing `fuzzrun` and
# `buildstamp` -- two Go repositories -- by 2026-10-31. Nine days, two misses,
# and a list that silently omits a repository reports a clean fleet for it.
# Found by re-listing the organisations before shipping the lane, not by the
# lane telling anybody.
#
# ⛔ AND IT IS STILL A LIST, DELIBERATELY. Deriving it from `gh repo list` would
# remove the drift and cost the property this job is built on: vulnscan needs NO
# credential, because it clones and makes no REST call per repository, so it
# cannot starve the hourly budget the Renovate runners spend from. Enumerating
# the organisations needs a token and spends from that budget on every run. So
# this file is a POLICY -- which tools are worth a clone a day -- and not an
# inventory, and the drift is paid for by re-reading the organisations whenever
# it is edited. `fleetfind` is the tool for the inventory question.

# the token and the push guard
go-gitsafe/gitsafe

# the lease and memory protocol every session coordinates through
go-agentsync/agentsync

# the sweeps, the gates and the judges
go-fleettools/fleettools
go-fleettools/staletools
go-fleettools/prwait
go-fleettools/mutate
go-fleettools/modfloor
go-fleettools/landingkit
go-fleettools/unbounded
go-fleettools/fleetfind
go-fleettools/landingdiff

# added 2026-10-31, after re-listing the organisations: both are Go, both were
# created since this file was first written, and neither was being watched
go-fleettools/fuzzrun
go-fleettools/buildstamp
